# komodo_user (Resource)

Manages a Komodo user. Supports local (password) and service (API key) user types.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Globally unique username. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `admin` (Boolean) Whether the user has global admin permissions. Requires super-admin credentials to set.
- `create_build_permissions` (Boolean) Whether the user has permission to create builds.
- `create_server_permissions` (Boolean) Whether the user has permission to create servers.
- `description` (String) Description for service users.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is enabled and able to access the API.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for local users. Sensitive. Not applicable to service users.
- `user_type` (String) User type: "local" (password-based) or "service" (API key-based). Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the user.
- `super_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is a super-admin. Read-only — managed outside Terraform.
